title: Match Hamiltonian, ancilla, radius and generator before claiming a lifetime
statement: At uniform capped perturbation strength, choose R_k=floor(a2^(k/3))-1 using the common static patch bound and exact Gaussian coherent/jump tails. The reviewed full defect and logical-twirl budgets yield every-purified-input fidelity>=1-2exp(-b2^(k/3)/2) and diamond error<=2sqrt(2)exp(-b2^(k/3)/4) throughout0<=time<=exp(b2^(k/3)/4), beyond the explicit uniform onset. This implies the conservative source exp(c n_k^alpha) interval.

requires: Actual accepted five-qubit-seeded even RX/RZ family with fixed qualified ell, R3 bounded density/range/incidence, distance and uniform check filling
H=H0+sum V_i, H0=sum(I-S_j)/2, beta>beta_c in one-unit defect convention; actual uniform Pauli-l1/charge/KP bounds and onset
For EACH actual H separately: exactly stationary Gaussian CKG dynamics adapted to THAT H, all3n seeds and actual coherent correction, optional same-H drift
One shared exact logical decoder; for EACH H prepare the corresponding Gibbs-derived ancilla tau_H and actual positive encoder
provides: An internally accepted conditional all-input logical storage theorem for the stated Hamiltonian-adapted model family
assumptions: Quantifiers are: for every allowed actual H there exists its own exactly stationary generator and H-derived encoding ancilla, with shared decoder
No single prechosen controller/initializer for unknown H; no native bath or fixed-radius physical truncation
Static/radius/dynamical obligations close within these assumptions; physical implementations need full accumulated-error and access budgets
Do not transfer the theorem to the separate provisional two-body ground-phase model
costs: Conservative fixed temperature/perturbation/geometric/LR constants, support-radius scaling,3n per-site clock and onset all paid
Source n_k<=5g^(2k), alpha=ln2/(6ln g)>0; lifetime exp(c n_k^alpha) with possibly terrible native constants
Physical Gibbs-ancilla preparation, implementation of exact filters/coherent correction, controls/readout and accumulated actual imperfections remain unacquired
contract.units: Every-purified-input overlap fidelity and full diamond error, constant per-site clock, source size exponent and uniform large-size onset.
contract.obstruction: Matching nominal locality without matching actual H-dependent stationarity and initialization changes the theorem.

body: For EACH allowed actual perturbed H, choose ITS OWN exactly stationary Gaussian generator with coherent correction and ITS OWN Gibbs-derived encoding ancilla. The logical decoder is shared. Neither controller nor initializer is fixed before unknown H is chosen. This is not a native physical bath/device, generic nonstationary noise, two-body endpoint lifetime, efficient preparation or useful numerical advantage. Slow FULL Gibbs mixing does not rule out efficient ancilla/sector initialization. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.
